title: Hearty Reduced Ukrainian Cranberry Stew
description: A pungent and shattering solo dinner dish featuring cranberry, this Ukrainian stew is macrobiotic friendly and cooked in a kazan cauldron. It is a perfect meal for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Heat the kazan cauldron over medium heat and add the chopped onion.
Saute the onion until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cranberries, carrots, and potatoes, and stir to combine.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and continue to simmer for another 10 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
